thread:
Avery: heads-up: we're seeing a sudden p99 increase on short-seq models after yesterday's driver roll. 3x p99 on g5x pools. any perf folks awake?
Ravi: noticing same, looks correlated with the kernel autoselect flip that started ~02:00 UTC. p50 unchanged, p99 up.
Elena: @Avery can you paste the selector log? wondering if it's preferring the larger workspace kernel now.
Avery: here's snippet from selector telemetry (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-18T02:00:12Z] model=shortseq_v2 seq=64 batch=1 hw=g5x driver_ver=550.12 autoselect=flash_attn_v2
[2026-03-18T02:00:12Z] model=shortseq_v2 seq=16 batch=8 hw=g5x driver_ver=550.12 autoselect=generic_gemm
[2026-03-18T02:00:13Z] model=shortseq_v2 seq=32 batch=4 hw=g5x autoselect=flash_attn_v2
```
Avery: but for a lot of requests the selector now prefers `flash_attn_v2` even when previously we used a small-sequence optimized kernel. p99 jumps when `flash_attn_v2` is used on short seqs.
Jon: do we have KV cache hit-rate changes? I suspect prefetch scheduler locality shift causing more KV evictions -> more re-compute so more time in attention.
Priya: I pulled kv telemetry for affected hosts: kv_hit_rate down from 98% -> 86% around 02:05. eviction_count spiked.
Sam: logs from infra show heavier PCIe stalls on a subset of hosts (~10%). noisy neighbor on the PCIe bus maybe. OpsBot: incident created #INC-2026-0132, assigned to eng-runtime/infra.
Ravi: can someone run the perf flamegraph for a repro window? particularly kernel launch times + kernel type histogram.
Elena: attaching condensed perf output (pasted):
```
Top kernels by time:
  flash_attn_v2_kernel        42%  (jumped from 10% pre-roll)
  small_attention_kernel       12%  (used to be 55%)
  cudaMemcpyAsync             18%
  kernel_launch_overhead       8%
```
Elena: kernel_launch_overhead also increased ~2-3x on the noisy hosts.
Avery: interesting — so selector prefers flash_attn_v2 (bigger workspace) but we've got both higher memcpy and launch overheads. that combo would kill short-seq latency.
Ravi: why did selector flip? recent triton patch added a minor heuristic: prefer kernels with higher arithmetic intensity when driver reports newer cuCtx attributes. suspect it misinterprets capability flags after driver update.
Priya: repro steps: roll forward driver 550.12 -> run shortseq_v2 load with seq distribution skewed to 8-32, batcher config default. observe kernel histogram.
Jon: quick mitigation options: 1) pin kernel selector to prefer small-attention for seq<=64; 2) adjust prefetch scheduler to increase KV affinity so we avoid memcpy churn; 3) roll driver back.
Avery: can we try 1) first? low-risk. Ravi / Elena, can you push a canary to 5% that forces kernel_id=small_attention for seq<=64?
Ravi: will do. creating canary route now and adding a telemetry flag.
InfraBot: Canary deployment started to 5% of g5x pool (hosts: g5x-02,g5x-09).
Sam: note: if root cause is PCIe contention, forcing kernel might mask but not fix. need infra to surface noisy VM tenants.
Priya: after canary rollout p99 on canary hosts dropped back to baseline within 10 minutes. non-canary still high.
Elena: confirmed kernel histogram on canary: small_attention 78%, flash_attn_v2 10%. p99 normal.
Ravi: ok promising. I'll extend canary to 30% and add an automated rollback timer.
Jon: parallelly infra: can you correlate PCIe stall metrics with tenant allocations? Sam?
Sam: looking. g5x-03 & g5x-07 show PCIe stall spike, both co-located with a new batch training job from partner account. opening vendor contact.
Avery: decision: keep kernel pin for short seqs while infra pursues noisy tenant remediation and we push a triton selector patch to revert the heuristic. Ops: update incident status.
OpsBot: incident #INC-2026-0132 updated: mitigation=kernel-pin-canary extended, next-step=infra noisy-tenant investigation, owner=Ravi.
Ravi: filing runtime PR to add a selector fallback override + telemetry flag so we can toggle without deploy. PR: https://git.internal/repo/rt-selector/pull/421
Priya: also raising a monitoring alert to detect kv_hit_rate drop >5% in 5m window and autoswitch to small kernel.
Elena: postmortem action items: 1) revert triton heuristic in next release; 2) add kernel selector unit test for driver attribute changes; 3) improve prefetch scheduler to prefer locality when PCIe latency > threshold; 4) infra: noisy tenant eviction policy.
Avery: thanks all. will keep thread updated. feel free to ping on pager if it regresses. :thumbsup:
